research.name: Tegaki
research.note: Turns any font into handwriting that draws itself stroke by stroke, with bindings for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid and Astro.

effects: stroke-by-stroke handwriting animation generated from any font
strokes drawn along the glyph centerline at true width instead of tracing outlines
pressure-based stroke width with taper, glow and wobble plugins
CLI that writes a self-drawing looping SVG from a line of text
CJK stroke order taken from KanjiVG and Make Me a Hanzi

unverified: The only animation seen running was the README's hello-world.svg, caught mid-draw in one screenshot ("Written b" partly written in a script font); it was a single frame, so the stroke order and timing were not watched from start to finish.
The Tegaki Studio page loaded and showed its controls (Glow, Wobble, Pressure width, Taper, Stroke gradient) but stayed on "Generating strokes..." and never rendered text in this session.

The tegaki.ink homepage could not be opened in the browser (navigation aborted); its content was read as text only, so centerline drawing, the plugins, CJK stroke order sources, scroll-driven and streaming playback are taken from the site's and README's descriptions, not observed.
requiresHostedService is false by inference from the README (npm package with bundled fonts and a local CLI); the package was not installed or run.
